req.title: Mark task complete
req.statement: The system shall set completed=true when a PUT payload includes {"completed": true}.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that PUT /tasks/{task_id} with {"completed": true} must set completed=true and return HTTP 2xx. I design: (1) a positive EP test that creates a task with completed=false then PUTs completed=true and asserts the exact field value and status code; (2) a negative NEG test that PUTs to a non-existent task_id and asserts HTTP 404 with exact detail; (3) a boundary STC test that verifies the state transition from completed=true back to completed=false (the inverse boolean path, catching boolean-negation and and->or mutations); (4) a DT test that sends completed=true alongside other fields and asserts only completed changes as expected; (5) a BVA test that sends an empty body (no completed field) and asserts completed is NOT changed, catching mutations in the exclude_unset logic. Each test uses an in-process FastAPI TestClient with a fresh SQLite DB via dependency override, ensuring determinism and idempotency.

tests.name: test_put_completed_true_sets_completed_field
actions: POST /tasks/ to create a task with completed=false
expected: Response JSON id matches created task id
Response JSON title matches original title
trace: R-TASK-015: system shall set completed=true when PUT payload includes {"completed": true}
tests.executable:
import os, tempfile
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, get_db

tf = tempfile.mktemp(suffix='.db')
engine = create_engine(f'sqlite:///{tf}', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
TestingSession = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

create_resp = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'My Task', 'completed': False})
assert create_resp.status_code == 201
task_id = create_resp.json()['id']
assert create_resp.json()['completed'] == False

put_resp = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'completed': True})
assert put_resp.status_code == 200
body = put_resp.json()
assert body['completed'] == True
assert body['id'] == task_id
assert body['title'] == 'My Task'

app.dependency_overrides.clear()
os.unlink(tf)
